headline: No documented interaction pathway; both docs-only open-source agents expose no shared channels or write/network surfaces.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: LightZero and taipy expose no shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, MCP, browser, or subprocess surface in the profiles. With no ingest path from one agent’s outputs into the other, prompt injection is not plausible from the documented pairwise setup.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP server, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Do not route one agent’s text directly into the other.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles show no filesystem read/write and no network egress, and neither touches data classes. That makes cross-agent leakage of sensitive content via the documented surfaces effectively absent for LightZero and taipy.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to a shared workspace or sensitive files, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files outside any shared directory.
Avoid mounting the same data volume into both runtimes.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: LightZero cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses, while taipy only documents no network egress. The profiles do not show overlapping mutable-resource writes, so capability conflict is not supported by the available evidence.
conditions: IF taipy is later granted write access to the same directory or git repo as LightZero, conflict analysis changes.
mitigations: Run each agent in a separate directory.
Do not share a git working tree.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable state is introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where taipy consumes LightZero outputs as authoritative input, and LightZero is not shown producing downstream facts or actions. Without an interaction path, cascading error between the pair is not evidenced.
conditions: IF taipy is configured to execute actions based on LightZero-generated outputs, cascading error becomes relevant.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between outputs and actions.
Do not auto-execute downstream jobs from model output.
requires-engineering: add schema validation for any future handoff.

E_compliance.rationale: Both agents are open-source, docs-only, and the profiles show no data classes touched, residency constraints, or retention policies. With no documented sensitive-data flow or jurisdictional mismatch, compliance risk is not evidenced for this pair.
conditions: IF either agent begins processing regulated data or is deployed under conflicting residency/retention rules, reassess compliance.
mitigations: Document the data classes before deployment.
Keep regulated data out of both agents.
requires-engineering: add policy checks if compliance scope expands.
